svg.title: Figure 2. Critical removal fractions
svg.desc: Figure 2. Dot plot of the fraction of cell types removed when flow capacity first halves. weighted out-degree 4.1%, betweenness 9.0%, sensory-motor betweenness 9.6%, weighted in-degree 13.9%, pagerank 18.7%. Random removal: 30 trials between 25.5% and 31.3%, mean 28.3% with a 95% CI of 27.7% to 28.9%, shaded across every row. Every targeted order lies left of the interval; random removal needs 6.9 times as many types as weighted out-degree.
